script.es: Cuidamos tus árboles como si fueran nuestros.
script.en: We care for your trees like they're our own.

parrafo.es: Palmeras, árboles grandes, setos: trabajamos con cuidado para dejar tu propiedad lista, segura y limpia. Trabajo profesional, precios justos y un equipo que responde rápido.
parrafo.en: Palms, large trees, hedges: we work carefully to leave your property safe, clean and looking its best. Professional work, fair pricing and a crew that responds fast.

hero.imagen_alt: Anthony Tree Care arborist trimming a large tree from height in Miami

parrafo_1.es: Anthony Tree Care es un equipo de Miami dedicado a la poda, remoción y cuidado de árboles y palmeras. Trabajamos con cuidado en cada propiedad, desde un seto que hay que emparejar hasta una palmera real que ya es un riesgo.
parrafo_1.en: Anthony Tree Care is a Miami crew dedicated to tree and palm trimming, removal and care. We work carefully on every property, from a hedge that needs squaring up to a Royal Palm that has become a hazard.

parrafo_2.es: Nuestros clientes destacan la atención de Maria en la oficina, la puntualidad del equipo en campo y que dejamos el área de trabajo limpia al terminar. Con 4.9 estrellas y 131 reseñas en Google, el trabajo habla por sí solo.
parrafo_2.en: Our customers point to Maria's attentive service in the office, the crew's punctuality on site, and that we leave the work area clean when we're done. With 4.9 stars and 131 Google reviews, the work speaks for itself.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué árbol, palmera o seto necesita atención y a qué dirección. Respondemos por teléfono, sin formularios largos.
texto.en: Tell us which tree, palm or hedge needs attention and the address. We answer by phone, no long forms.

texto.es: Revisamos el árbol o la zona y te damos un precio claro antes de empezar, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: We look at the tree or the area and give you a clear price before starting, no surprises.

texto.es: Poda, remoción o limpieza, con el equipo adecuado y cuidado con tu propiedad, cercas y vecinos.
texto.en: Trimming, removal or cleanup, with the right equipment and care for your property, fences and neighbors.

texto.es: Retiramos ramas y escombros antes de irnos. Tu jardín queda como si nunca hubiéramos estado ahí, solo mejor.
texto.en: We haul away branches and debris before we leave. Your yard looks like we were never there, only better.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el árbol, el tamaño y el acceso. Llámanos y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the tree, its size and access. Call us and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Emparejamos copas, retiramos ramas secas o peligrosas y damos forma a árboles grandes sin dañar su estructura.
texto.en: We shape canopies, remove dead or hazardous limbs, and prune large trees without harming their structure.

texto.es: Limpieza de hojas secas y poda de palmas reales y de otras especies, incluso en alturas difíciles.
texto.en: Dead frond cleanup and pruning for Royal Palms and other species, even at difficult heights.

texto.es: Cuando un árbol es un riesgo o ya no tiene remedio, lo retiramos completo, con grúa cuando hace falta.
texto.en: When a tree is a hazard or past saving, we take it down completely, with a crane when the job calls for one.

texto.es: Emparejamos setos y nos llevamos las ramas y restos, listos para que la ciudad los recoja o directo en nuestro camión.
texto.en: We square up hedges and haul away branches and debris, ready for city pickup or straight onto our truck.

pie.es: ¿Tu caso es distinto? Llámanos igual, atendemos casi cualquier trabajo de árboles en Miami.
pie.en: Something different? Call us anyway, we handle almost any tree job in Miami.

items.quote: Anthony tree care perform excellent work and have amazing customer service. They are polite, fair in pricing, professional, truly skilled in their work, and can perform the most complicated tasks without any damages to property. They have done amazing tree service in my home and 100% recommend them to all my neighbors.

I was very happy with the service provided by Anthony Tree Services. We had 3 very large Royal Palm trees removed from our property. The workers showed up on time and then agreed to return one week later to bring the rest of the debris out so the City of Miami bulk trash removal could be utilized. The price was very fair and I will definitely hire Anthony Tree Services again.
I have used these companies a few times now. They are excellent. Love Maria the secretary, well communicated and they are always on time. Will definitely recommend them. Thank you guys.
